items.t: Jaguar Health Shares Fall 18.8% Following 109% Rally After Reverse Stock Split
items.sum: Jaguar Health Inc (NASDAQ:JAGX) shares declined 18. 8% in premarket trading on Wednesday, reversing part of the previous session’s 109% gain following the implementation of a reverse stock split and a pharmaceutical manufacturing update.
